page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal instance type designed for GPU-accelerated workloads. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 6.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance is equipped with four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of dedicated vCPUs, substantial memory capacity, and quad-GPU configuration, this instance represents a high-resource hardware class. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that can fully parallelize across multiple GPUs and 128 dedicated cores. Appropriate workloads include deep learning training, large-scale AI inference, high-performance computing, and complex graphics rendering.
